observations: The page number «77» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 continues chapters 28-28b from p. 76 (JP2 0108, L29-L33).

L01-L05: the transliteration as printed: «el-ẓill el-mustawī», «el-ẓill el-mankūs», «maʿkūs», «el-ẓill el-mabsūṭ», «el-ẓill el-muntaṣib», «el-ḳā’im», in italics, with the dots under ẓ, ṭ, ṣ and ḳ, the macrons, the ʿayn raised and the apostrophe of the hamza; al-ẓill al-mustawī, al-ẓill al-mankūs, al-ẓill al-mabsūṭ, al-ẓill al-muntaṣib, al-qāʾim.

L08, L11-L14: the formulas, those of L08 and L11 displayed and centred, those of L12-L14 within the lines; their fractions built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}, and the square roots printed with a V-shaped radical and a bar over «12² + cot²α», «1 + cot²α» and «1 + tg²α», written {rt:…}; α italic, sin, cos, tg, cot upright, «·» the raised dot of multiplication; L11 «sin (90 — α)», the minus a long dash with a space on either side. L12: a wide gap (96 px) after the colon of «Formel :».

L08-L14. Checked: with a gnomon of 12, the shadow of the altitude α is 12 cos α : sin α and the upright shadow 12 sin α : cos α (L08); the shadow s = 12 cot α gives cos α = s : √(12² + s²), on a radius of 60 sin (90° − α) = 60 s : √(144 + s²) (L11), and with the cotangent of radius 1 cos α = cot α : √(1 + cot²α) (L12); likewise sin α = 1 : √(1 + cot²α) = tg α : √(1 + tg²α) and cos α = 1 : √(1 + tg²α) (L13-L14), for 0° < α < 90°.

L25: «(p. 69)», the remark on the readings of the sine table (p. 69, JP2 0101, L35-L39). L27-L35: Björnbo's sentence in German quotation marks, «Abū’l-Wefā» spaced, with the macrons and the apostrophe; the quotation of Abū’l-Wafāʾ that begins in L33 continues on p. 78. L33: «Almagestes» upright.

The dashes: L23 «gefasst. —», the long dash (44 px) after a word space; N01 «22—23» and «180—182», the long dash of the small type of the notes (33 and 30 px), printed faint; N02 «16–17», a dash of 27 px with a gap of 9 px on either side, transcribed as the short dash.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Batt.», «Ḥabash», «Björnbo», «Björnbos», «Maslama», «Abū’l-Wefā», «Nallino»; italics: the Arabic words of L01-L04, «zweiter,», «erster», the letters of the formulas, the title of N02.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (11-14 px measured; «hat ;» L22, 12 px).

critical_notes.evidence: the two page ranges are joined by «u.», as in «27 u. 187—189» (p. 74, JP2 0106, N02) and «67 u. 243» (p. 38, JP2 0070, N01); a full stop is printed after 23
